scope: Hosted-only syntax, declaration compilation and synthetic preservation/refusal checks
workflow:
name: Revision 8 helper parsing and refusal checks
on:
  push:
    branches: [task/type-binding-v8-checks-20261125]
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: type-binding-v8-checks-20261125
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  verify:
    if: github.repository == 'YossiMH/bead-me-up-scotty'
    runs-on: windows-2025
    timeout-minutes: 7
    env:
      GIT_CONFIG_COUNT: '2'
      GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0: core.autocrlf
      GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0: 'false'
      GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1: core.eol
      GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1: lf
      NODE_OPTIONS: '--max-old-space-size=128'
    steps:
      - name: Read exact preparation files
        uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          path: ci
          persist-credentials: false
          sparse-checkout: 20261125/revision-8/install-binding
      - name: Select qualified Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38
        with:
          node-version: '24.22.3'
          package-manager-cache: false
      - name: Parse exact helpers and compile declarations only
        shell: powershell -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command ". '{0}'"
        timeout-minutes: 2
        run: |
          $root=Join-Path $env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE 'ci/20261125/revision-8/install-binding'
          $parser=Join-Path $root 'parse-bindings.ps1'
          if((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $parser -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() -cne 'ec8208f1313c948249260f5e24bf0d061ce135318eebd5c519f3dd2f902fa49b'){throw 'Parser changed.'}
          & $parser -Directory $root -ManifestSha256 '3b45e61b55ecd89533b50cd04290bf838a93e443f37187a5973d3fd8e11df008'
          if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}
      - name: Check synthetic installer refusals
        shell: powershell -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command ". '{0}'"
        timeout-minutes: 2
        run: |
          $root=Join-Path $env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE 'ci/20261125/revision-8/install-binding'
          $helper=Join-Path $root 'check-binding-refusals.ps1'
          if((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $helper -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() -cne '8a4e50c74f6f60485ada94a405ba934d396c578ebed8bd02f7027ff170dfcf3c'){throw 'Refusal helper changed.'}
          & $helper -Directory $root -ManifestSha256 '3b45e61b55ecd89533b50cd04290bf838a93e443f37187a5973d3fd8e11df008'
          if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}
      - name: Check synthetic task mapping refusals
        shell: powershell -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command ". '{0}'"
        timeout-minutes: 1
        run: |
          $root=Join-Path $env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE 'ci/20261125/revision-8/install-binding'
          $helper=Join-Path $root 'check-history-refusals.mjs'
          if((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $helper -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() -cne '2203062499453164496be312e57d484b93fc60cbb2f46c7b20e390242bd6cd11'){throw 'History refusal helper changed.'}
          & node.exe --check $helper
          if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}
          & node.exe $helper $root '3b45e61b55ecd89533b50cd04290bf838a93e443f37187a5973d3fd8e11df008'
          if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}
      - name: Retain actual parser and refusal outputs
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: bead-binding-checks-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: error
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/bead-binding-checks-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}/
